The '''Pocket Tech''' was a model of [[Emergency repair patch/Legends|emergency repair patch]] produced by the [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]] and available in the period following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. Consisting of a small semi-flexible disc of [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]] with auto-activating thermal welds along the edges, the patch could be used in emergencies to seal small holes in objects, [[Droid/Legends|droids]] or vehicles. Each Pocket Tech cost 25 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="EOTE" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Pocket Tech was first mentioned in the ''[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire]] [[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook|Core Rulebook]]'' released by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] in [[2013]].
